tool-fit.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, identity preservation.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is an IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY for Canon's approved r41 HEAD SHAPE; do not copy its black background, body pose, hand, notebook position, lighting or studio setting into the target.
Make one local change ONLY to Canon's outer felt head silhouette in image 1: make it visibly SQUATTIER, LOWER and BROADER, a broad soft RECTANGULAR CUBOID like r41. Target the outer head excluding antenna at approximately 1.4 units wide to 1 unit high. Flatten the roof into a shallow crown with softly rounded corners and a visible side plane; remove the excess tall felt cap above the face. It must not read as a sphere, round dome, tall cube, or bulbous cap. Achieve the lower broader silhouette by reducing excess felt above the face and modestly broadening the outer shell, not by stretching or squashing the eyes or the whole picture.
Keep the exact oval woven digital eyes, their tall vertical oval shape and normal proportions, dark pupils contained and centered within each ivory eye, pixel smile, woven face texture and expression. Keep the antenna and cream antenna tip, correctly attached to the lowered roof.
Lock every other part of image 1: exact body, limbs, hands, posture, task, task geometry, props and their occlusions, composition, camera, perspective, warm workshop, light, shadows, materials, color and frame edges. Do not move, resize or warp the body or objects. Identity-reference guidance applies ONLY to the head silhouette. No new objects, text, logos, lights, glass or metal. Preserve the same landscape framing and exact 1536 by 1024 dimensions.
Task-specific invariants: Canon holds the wooden round peg beside the matching round receiving tool with a visible gap. Preserve exact peg/socket geometry, gap, hand grip, measuring ribbon, wooden base and other props.

shared-repair.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original CREATE SOMETHING website task scene, landscape 1536x1024 still. Input 1 is the authoritative Canon identity: reproduce its squat charcoal felt body, soft cuboid head, oval cream woven pixel eyes with dark oval pupils, woven tiny smile, single cream-ball felt antenna, little stitched coat/pocket/notebook and gentle soft mitten hands. Input 2 supplies the approved warm workshop material and lighting family. Input 3 is ONLY the old task/composition reference; replace its old metal/stone characters completely with the approved single felt identity. Create an original scene in pale wood, cream paper and matte ceramic, with a charcoal felt background wall, softly lit. Task objects must be recognizable and complete. Preserve the character's short, squat proportions and facial expression as woven pixels, not flat screen graphics. Composition: complete scene, subject/task in the center-right and lower two-thirds, quiet charcoal felt wall at upper left; all hands and task objects visible; no text, no logos, no type, no watermark. Square artwork composition; no UI chrome or labels. No stone/metal robot anatomy, articulated exposed joints, glossy plastic, round eyes, creepy flat face, glowing effects, new mascots or extra companions. Keep whimsy gently task-related. Primary request: One Canon repairs a small shared wooden gear assembly on a workbench. Two gears are correctly meshed, one loose wooden axle and a small wooden hand tool show maintenance in progress; one detached curved support waits beside the assembly. Keep both soft hands involved in the task and the gear mechanism clearly legible, with a tiny cream ribbon flag attached to a spare gear for gentle whimsy. No second old companion. One character only.

subtract-route.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the ONLY edit target, an existing Canon workshop task scene. Image 2 is the authoritative approved r41 Canon identity reference ONLY for head proportions/material/face, NOT for background, camera or pose. Make one localized HEAD-ONLY refinement in Image 1. The head must become lower and broader like Image 2: a squat wide soft cuboid with approximately 1.4:1 visible width-to-height excluding the antenna, a flatter roof, shallow crown, softly squared corners and a clear dimensional side plane. Reduce excess felt mass above the face and remove the tall/domed cranium impression. It should be whimsical and squat, not a near-square head, rounded dome or tall block. Rebuild the head volume naturally in the existing perspective; NEVER vertically squash the whole face, rescale the body, or warp the image. Preserve tall cream VERTICAL OVAL woven pixel eyes, contained centered dark oval pupils, gentle small pixel-stitch smile, dimensional felt fiber texture, and the single short felt antenna with cream wool ball. Keep eyes upright and tall with no squashing, no circular eyes, no screen glass or glow. Maintain the current character's head orientation/gaze and facial expression, with the neck/head attachment natural and body/coat/limbs/hands/feet/pocket/notebook exactly as Image 1. Preserve every other pixel intent: exact task objects and their marks, pose, camera angle and distance, composition, native square aspect ratio, full framing, workshop background, tabletop, wood/paper/ceramic materials, warm lighting, shadows and existing task-connected whimsy. Do NOT import Image 2's black background or standing pose. Do NOT add any character/body, stone, metal, shiny plastic, text, logo or watermark. TASK LOCK: Keep the exact arch-shaped lifted paper strip in both hands, straight paper route between two round cream anchors on its wooden board, loose curl on the right, and all pencils and trays unchanged.
